lede: Thanksgiving week lands on Telluride with the Turkey Trot on Thursday morning, Alpine Chapel's free community Friendsgiving on Sunday, and a full calendar of events carrying the valley through the holiday. On the government side, it's a quiet week — the Open Space Commission, the Board of County Commissioners work session, and the Medical Center board all have agendas that haven't been posted yet, so there's nothing to track down or weigh in on before the holiday.
